```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("TBL.PGA.TR", inherits = FALSE)) stop("executive results: the caller must define TBL.PGA.TR, the id of the table it places.", call. = FALSE)
if (!exists("ExecutiveSummary", inherits = FALSE)) {
  source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "executiveResults.R"))
}
if (!exists("PSA_Units", inherits = FALSE)) PSA_Units <- "g"
Units <- .executiveUnits(PSA_Units)
SEP <- " to "
Demand <- ExecutiveSummary$demand
Conditions <- sort(unique(Demand$Vs30))
PGA.MDE <- .executiveRange(Demand$SaF, SEP, function(v) .fmtSa(v, PSA_Units))
Across <- if (uniqueN(Demand$siteID) > 1L) paste0("across the site conditions of ", knitr::combine_words(SiteTable$label, and = " and ")) else "across the site conditions"
Envelopes <- if (!is.null(MCETable) && nrow(MCETable)) " together with the deterministic envelopes MCE and MCE (84%)" else ""
```

- **Site Response.** The design ground motions are defined for the $V_{S30}$ conditions evaluated at each site from the spectral demand at the surface. The design demands were evaluated for `r .fmti(length(Conditions))` site conditions, with $V_{S30}$ from `r .fmti(min(Conditions))` to `r .fmti(max(Conditions))` m/s, by combining the direct logic-tree evaluation at each condition with the ST20 transformation of the demand at the reference condition of 760 m/s, conditioned on the PGA of the same realization. The mean PGA of the MDE is `r PGA.MDE` `r Units` `r Across`. These results represent ergodic mean responses; a specific stratigraphic profile requires a separate site-response analysis. Table [-@`r TBL.PGA.TR`] reports, for each site and site condition, the probabilistic PGA`r Envelopes`.

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(list = intersect(c("SEP", "Units", "Demand", "Conditions", "PGA.MDE", "Across", "Envelopes"), ls()))
```
